decisions.executionNote: Begin elbow-up approach, left toward toy cars and right toward plush figures. Reserve white for cars, blue for watches, red for plush.
Approach green watch with left and rightmost plush with right, pitching grippers toward tabletop while maintaining elbow-up continuity.
Fine-align the green watch from wrist view and close left; close right around plush torso, then make a small retention lift.
Lift both grasp candidates and begin separate transfers: green watch toward blue, plush toward red. Retention will be checked in RGB.
RGB shows both objects remained on table. Reapproach lower: left switches to nearest gold car, right aligns over plush torso; open before descending.
Wrist-align gold car and plush torso, descend a few centimeters for side contact, close fully and make a short test lift.
Both objects now appear between the fingers. Lift clear while keeping closed, then translate car toward white and plush toward red.
Carry retained car and plush fully over their basket interiors, then lower modestly; keep closed until placement alignment is visible.
Left car slipped; withdraw and lower the empty left wrist to avoid the rejected high reach. Lower retained right plush into red and release.
Allow plush to release in red, then withdraw toward the remaining plush. Recenter left over the fallen car's midsection and close lower around its sides.
Car shifted toward the robot; lift and recenter over its new position before another descent. Align right over remaining plush torso and close at the successful grasp height.
Recenter left on the rolled car and close gently at side height; lift the centered plush and carry toward red with unchanged grasp orientation.
Lift the side-grasped car slowly. The second plush fell back onto the table; reopen right and return above its new torso position.
Car remains retained; carry it over white without further elevation. Use wrist-view offset to recenter right on the shifted plush.
Place the retained car inside white and open. Center right fingers on plush torso, descend slightly, close, and perform a short retention lift.
First car is in white. Approach the second car with left; lift the newly retained plush straight up and begin transfer to red.
Lower and close around the second car, then test-lift. Carry the retained plush into the red basket and open near the interior floor.
Lift the second car for transfer to white. Withdraw open right from the two plush figures in red and approach the black watch.
Replan after rejected right retreat with smaller steps. The second car slipped; open left, align closing axis across its body and approach lower.
Recenter the left fingers over the car body and close lower, then test lift. Approach black watch with open right gripper.
Lift the centered second car with unchanged orientation. Align right over the watch band, descend to side contact and close.
Transfer retained car toward white at moderate height. Test-lift the watch before committing to its longer transfer.
Left tracking degraded near the basket lip: retract slightly and tilt forward to regain clearance, keeping closed. Regrasp right watch lower around the band.
Raise the hanging car to clear the basket lip before further forward motion. Test watch retention with a straight, slow lift.
Both latest lifts lost retention. Reopen and approach the car leaning outside white and the relocated watch, using lower contact heights.
Wrist views show both objects slightly left of the pinch center. Correct laterally, lower to flank contact, close fully, and test lift.
Lift both straight up with closed grippers to verify retention and gain basket-rim clearance before any lateral transfer.
Both objects remain retained after vertical lift. Move car beyond the white basket's front rim and carry watch toward blue, keeping arms in separate workspaces.
Lower the car into white and release. Bring the retained watch over the right half of blue, adding a slight forward tilt for reach margin.
Release black watch safely inside blue and withdraw. Move open left toward the remaining green watch after leaving the cars in white.
Black watch is visibly in blue. Align and close lower on the green watch band; move right clear toward its own home side.
Test green-watch retention with a mostly vertical lift, while continuing a smooth elbow-up right-arm retreat toward origin.
Green watch stayed on the table. Reapproach nearer its face and lower than the missed band grasp; finish right-arm return with small continuous increments.
Green watch band is now centered across the open fingers at table height. Close without translation, then lift vertically to verify retention.
Green watch remains fixed between the fingers after lifting. Raise to rim clearance and begin transferring toward the left half of blue.
Carry the retained green watch toward blue with level, continuous motion; right remains at its home-side pose.
Move green watch fully inside blue, lower with clearance from the rim, and open to release beside the black watch.
Both watches are in blue. Withdraw open left clear of the basket and angle its gripper toward the final center car, keeping right parked.
Approach the final gold car from the left with an angled gripper, keeping the wrist near the centerline and right arm parked.
Fine-align across the final car body from the wrist view, lower to its sides, close, and make a short vertical retention test.
Lift the last car gradually while drawing leftward into the left workspace; retain the grasp orientation and verify it clears the table.
The last car slipped back to the table. Reopen and reapproach its center, slightly behind the prior edge grasp, for a lower flank grasp.
The car is now centered between open fingers. Lower vertically to grip its body rather than its top, close fully, pause, and test a small lift.
Lift the centered final car vertically with the gripper closed; only begin drawing left after gaining clearance. Check retention before the basket transfer.
The final car remains retained. Transfer leftward toward white at rim-clearing height, gradually aligning the wrist with the basket approach.
Carry the final car beyond white's front rim, lower into its open right-side space, and release beside the other two cars.
All categories appear in separate baskets. Withdraw the open left gripper above the cars and start returning home; make a small right-origin correction.
Three cars, two watches, and two plush figures are visible in their respective baskets. Continue the open left-arm return, maintaining elbow-up continuity.
